instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to do in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to do</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Usually, my parents do the laundry at home.
atoms.b: Usually, my parents ((do)) the laundry at home.

atoms.sound: Yesterday, my brother did it for the first time.

atoms.sound: He has never done the laundry himself before.
atoms.b: He has never ((done)) the laundry himself before.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to go in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to go</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Every Friday, I go to the cinema with my best friend.
atoms.b: Every Friday, I ((go)) to the cinema with my best friend.

atoms.sound: Last week, I went there with my brother.
atoms.b: Last week, I ((went)) there with my brother.

atoms.sound: I have never gone to the cinema alone.
atoms.b: I have never ((gone)) to the cinema alone.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to have in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to have</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I have got a brand new guitar.
atoms.b: I ((have)) got a brand new guitar.

atoms.sound: A week ago, I still had my old one.
atoms.b: A week ago, I still ((had)) my old one.

atoms.sound: I have had my new guitar for five days now.
atoms.b: I ((have)) ((had)) my new guitar for five days now.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to be in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: He has been back in London for a week now.
